mechanism.claim: An upper-tail burst in realized variation of the ETH/BTC relative-price path identifies rapid rotation in crypto risk appetite. The completed ETH/BTC ratio direction maps risk-on ETH outperformance long BTC and risk-off ETH underperformance short BTC for eight hours while BTC variation is elevated.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed ETH/BTC relative return
mechanism.why_distinct: ETH leadership requires same-sign absolute-return dominance, disagreement requires opposite asset signs, jump catchup isolates one ETH jump, and beta catchup fits a prior regression. HVERVR uses the quadratic variation and endpoint direction of the ETH/BTC relative-price path without individual-sign restrictions or prior event reuse.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: BTC completed eight-hour realized-variation strict-prior rank>=0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily relative-variation onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.aligned_window: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows per symbol over [D-8h,D)
features.relative_minute_return: log(ETH close/open)-log(BTC close/open) at each aligned minute
features.relative_variation: sum squared relative minute returns, finite strict positive
features.relative_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.relative_return: log((ETH last close/BTC last close)/(ETH first open/BTC first open)), finite strict nonzero
features.btc_variation: sum squared BTC minute log(close/open), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent ETH/BTC relative-price variation risk channel

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no asset, relative-return, variation, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
